The Moon strutted into Leo this morning.

The Moon moved into Leo early this morning, and Venus sent Jupiter a friendly sextile around 7 am. The Sun makes a friendly trine to the Moon this evening. Swipe for Gemini, Libra and Aquarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Air friend. 🌙
